items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: Where's the little Stable Bluett? You got it over there. Just look there, right here. The little Stable Bluett.

ctx.x: And here's my stop. That's the Dixieland stop. That shows that they had heard the original Dixieland jazz band records. When they put that stop behind it, they're clarinet part.

I'm going to pull this record apart for you right now. I'm going to show you these Negroes copy us. You heard that part there? Where's the little Stable Bluett? You got it over there. Just look there, right here. The little Stable Bluett. Now, I want you to listen to this my cornet part.
